name: Girls Frontline Music Pack
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

Mod adds in the GFL or Girls Frontline OST to SPT. Has music from the latest events. also included music from Neural Cloud and GFL 2 (tho not fully)

Install Instructions: Drag BepinEx folder into your SPT directory

Updated to SPT 3.10.X versions.
